text: Included in the CPS, and this means that at the MAC layer, they will consider the channel as busy for all that time. So now I hope we better understand why RTS and CPS represent an explicit channel reservation. Because who sends RTS informs all its neighbors that they need to be silent for a certain time corresponding to the expected duration of the dialogue, and who sends the CPS informs its neighbors that the channel is going to be busy because of its dialogue. So they reserve radio resources for the non-dialog by sending RTS and CPS. Here, okay, so you may think well, RTS and CPS is great, solves all our problems, right? Well, there are some drawbacks here. What are the drawbacks? First of all, RTS and CPS are control packets. They do not carry any application level information, right? So they do not carry any useful information from the application layer point of view. They are just control packets. They are short, but control packets except for acknowledgments in Wi-Fi are always transmitted at the basic rate. What does it mean that they are?
